# Project instructions

## Stack

- Python
- Pytest

## Rules

- Only edit the `triage.py` file.
- Do not modify the tests in `test_triage.py`.

## Tests

- The tests are located in `test_triage.py`.
- Run the tests using the `pytest -q` command.

## Classification rules

- Classification is case-insensitive.
- Precedence: question > bug > feature.
- Fall back to `feature` if no other classification matches.
